headline: Initial budget update, monthly financial review, and a minivan bid recommendation are on the agenda.
summary: The agenda opens with a closed executive session and a student presentation from Gertrude Chamberlin School. It also covers the initial budget update and Monitoring Report 2.11 Equity, which is up for action.
items: Proposed executive session, closed to the public, under 1 V.S.A. § 313(a)
Student learning: Gertrude Chamberlin School art and music students and a student representative report
Discussion items, including the monthly financial review, district report card (if unembargoed), and public comment policy
Action item: Monitoring Report 2.11 Equity, presented by Kat Yun
Consent agenda: 35 accounts payable orders, four voucher checks, and payroll warrants
Bid recommendation for a Honda Odyssey minivan
Set the agenda for the December 2, 2026 regular meeting and review future agenda items
